# Human MMP9 (P14780)
## UniProt Accession: P14780
## Full Name: Matrix metalloproteinase-9
## Organism: Homo sapiens (Human)
## Sequence:


## Manufacturer Information:
- **Enzo**: Produced in E. coli. Active recombinant matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9, gelatinase B, 92kDa type IV collagenase) cloned from human cDNA. The enzyme consists of residues Phe107-Pro449, which comprises the catalytic/fibronectin domain of human MMP-9, with a C-terminal His-tag.
- **Sino Biological**: Human, HEK293 Cells, Met1-Asp707. Recombinant Human Matrix Metalloproteinase-9 / MMP-9 (Met1-Asp707) is produced by our Mammalian expression system and the target gene encoding Met1-Asp707 is expressed with a 10His tag at the C-terminus.
